_doc: Reserved story flag names, grouped by namespace (SPEC-story-dialogue, week 6). Every flag a dialogue condition or progression hook can set or check must be declared here; the names are the contract between content and code. "persist": true marks an UNLOCK_FLAGS flag - set_flag writes it straight to the profile the moment it is set; everything else lives for the run and merges at run end through PlayerProfile.merge_run_gains. Authored by story-dialogue, week 6 Dev B.
